reason: The hypothesis cites no prior evidence, and its key premises about the specific mechanistic link between atomic size mismatch, lattice distortions, and dislocation motion in high-entropy alloys are not supported by any referenced studies.
premises: Atomic size mismatch can be systematically varied while keeping phase stability and processing constant.
Larger atomic size mismatch induces stronger local lattice distortions.
Local lattice distortions impede dislocation motion.
Impeded dislocation motion increases hardness and yield strength.
The effect dominates over other microstructural factors in single-phase HEAs.
